# Erdem Süren

> Full-Stack Software Engineer · .NET & React/Next.js. AI-native, end to end. Founder of Eribitech. İstanbul, Türkiye.

- Software Development Specialist at BELBİM: built belbim.istanbul and istanbulkart.istanbul; on the İstanbulkart mobile app team.
- Founder of Eribitech: Eribi, a multi-tenant e-commerce platform.
- Works with AI coding agents (Claude Code); owns architecture, review and release.
- Open to full-time roles and freelance projects.

Turkish at https://erdemsuren.com/, English under https://erdemsuren.com/en/.
